title: Patient Price Caps by Service Class for Patient Financial Assistance Program Award Discounts
content:
**Schedule.** An award discount on a patient invoice under the Patient Financial Assistance Program carries a patient price cap set by the service class of the order, as the order is held in Laboratory Test Orders.

| Service class of the order | Patient price cap |
|---|---|
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | $300.00 |
| Esoteric Reference Testing | $600.00 |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | $600.00 |
| Any other service class (Routine Clinical Testing, Specialty Clinical Testing, Clinical Toxicology Testing, Anatomic Pathology & Cytology) | No cap: the cap is the amount the award discount works on itself |

**How the cap acts.** The household's owed share is the smaller of the amount the award discount works on (the invoice's working amount) and the price cap, reduced by the award discount percent and rounded to the cent. The award discount before its limit is the whole working amount less that owed share. The cap therefore bounds what the household owes; it does not bound the discount.

## Worked figures (hypothetical invoices, award discount percent of 75)

| Order class | Working amount | Cap | Owed share figured on | Owed share (25 percent, to the cent) | Award discount before its limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | $1450.00 | $300.00 | $300.00 | $75.00 | $1375.00 |
| Esoteric Reference Testing | $520.00 | $600.00 | $520.00 | $130.00 | $390.00 |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | $980.00 | $600.00 | $600.00 | $150.00 | $830.00 |
| Routine Clinical Testing | $980.00 | none | $980.00 | $245.00 | $735.00 |

In the second row the working amount is below the $600.00 cap, so the cap does not change the owed share.
